scope: HECM-only explanatory analysis outside the cross-model robustness score
aggregation: windows averaged within each cell; equal-weight cell macro; 10000-draw cell bootstrap confidence intervals
adverse_gain_definition: larger cell-level delta MAE from the matched -3% and +3% current-gain runs
interaction_definition: adverse current-gain delta MAE under the perturbed lookup minus the adverse current-gain delta MAE under the nominal lookup
interpretation_boundary: The one-at-a-time shifts are controlled local sensitivity probes, not probabilistic lookup-table uncertainty bounds.
